innsbruck-austria.reason: Real photo, but it is an airport-terminal/control-tower view rather than a representative city view of Innsbruck.

jeju-island.reason: Real satellite photograph clearly showing Jeju Island in full.

iwo-jima-flag-raising.reason: Real photo, but it shows a close view of the Genaust memorial plaque rather than Mount Suribachi summit or the broader place.

jaws-menemsha-harbor.reason: Real photo clearly showing Menemsha Harbor and its waterfront at sunset.

jabalpur.reason: Real photo taken in Jabalpur, but it is an isolated Ganesha statue and not a city view.

kigali-rwanda.reason: Real photo taken in Kigali, but it focuses on an isolated genocide monument rather than the city.

kangaroo-island.reason: Real wildlife photo of geese in flight; it does not visibly establish or show Kangaroo Island as a place.

kinkakuji.reason: Real photo clearly showing Kinkaku-ji (the Golden Pavilion).

lake-balaton-d34-21.reason: Real panoramic photograph showing the Lake Balaton region and the lake.

lindbergh-spirit-st-louis-landing.reason: Real photo from an air show, but the aircraft is the subject and Le Bourget Airfield is not shown clearly as the place.

lifou-cliffs.reason: Real photo clearly showing the cliffs at Xodre on Lifou.

lake-garda.reason: Real photo showing Lake Garda, its mountainous shoreline, and a lakeside pier.

kyoto-japan.reason: Real photo taken in Kyoto, but it is a close view of one illuminated office-building facade rather than a city view.

kotors-old-town.reason: Real photo, but it shows Corfu Old Town and fortress in Greece, not Kotor Old Town in Montenegro.

kiritimati-london.reason: Real historical aerial photograph showing London settlement on Kiritimati beneath an aircraft.

lucca-walls-d34-50.reason: Real photo clearly showing a detail of Lucca's walls, matching the named landmark.

ljubljana-old-town-d34-29.reason: Real streetscape photograph clearly showing Ljubljana Old Town.

luxembourg-city.reason: Real cityscape photograph showing Luxembourg City's Pfaffenthal district, river, bridge, and surrounding buildings.

marion-island.reason: Real historical photo, but it depicts St. Helena Island, South Carolina, not Marion Island Station in South Africa.

mbuguni.reason: Not a real place photo; it is a scanned page from a mollusk journal and does not show Mbuguni.

marrakech-morocco.reason: Real photo taken in Marrakech, but it is a tight product/detail shot of hanging lanterns rather than a city view.

maheno-shipwreck.reason: Real photo clearly showing the Maheno shipwreck on the beach.

mcmurdo-hut-point.reason: Real photo from Hut Point clearly showing McMurdo Station and the surrounding Antarctic setting.

mecca-kaaba-saudi.reason: Real photo clearly showing the Kaaba at Masjid al-Haram.

matterhorn-summit.reason: Real aerial photograph clearly showing the Matterhorn summit.
